title: Gemini Decisions API
body: Gemini Decisions API Google join Jev and OpenAI in the decision model category with "Gemini Decision 1". This new model API is almost identical to Jev: it supports the same three types of questions (yes/no, choice, and rubric-scoring) and even reuses Jev's term "Noul" for a yes/no question. It's priced the same as the GPT-6 Luna decision model: 10 cents per million input tokens, and output is free. Jev remains the cheapest of the three, at 4.2 cents per million. Jev is text (and JSON) only. OpenAI can handle text and images. Gemini Decision 1 is fully multi-model: it covers text, images, audio, video, and PDFs. I tested it against video by passing these questions to it along with my Yonkers stomping robot video file: dragon: Does this video have a dragon in it? robot: Does this video have a robot in it? france: Is this video set in France? usa: Is this video set in the USA? Jev and OpenAI both return 1.0 or 0.0 for yes/no questions, but Gemini insists on being a little less confident than that: { "dragon" : { "type" : " yes_no " , "probability" : 0.04976021841520312 }, "robot" : { "type" : " yes_no " , "probability" : 0.9234055387792485 }, "france" : { "type" : " yes_no " , "probability" : 0.08329171353166241 }, "usa" : { "type" : " yes_no " , "probability" : 0.9230459995157706 } } Via Hacker News Tags: ai , generative-ai , gemini , llm-release , jev , decision-models

title: pktq/lasik
body:
BLA blinds your agent. LASIK gives it its sight back. Static de-blinding CLI + MCP server that undoes BLA (Blind LLM Agents) hardening so coding agents and REA can read the real code again. Never executes the target.

README 節錄： English · 简体中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español Static deobfuscation for anti-agent hardening. LASIK removes BLA protection layers so coding agents and analysis tools can read the real program. 0.3: structural detection. Protection is identified by what it does, not by its names, so renamed builds heal too. Benchmark How it works · Benchmark · Changelog LASIK reads a protected build, proves which parts are protection (opaque predicates, encrypted strings, decoy code, tamper checks, binary padding, prompt-injection text), removes them, and writes a clean copy. It never runs the input. ## Highlights - **1,262× fewer tokens** on the public BLA CrackMe corpus: about 21 million down to 17 thousand. - **Proof-based.** A transform runs only when LASIK can prove it preserves behaviour. Unprotected files come back byte-identical. - **Structural detection.** Protection is recognised by behaviour, not identifiers; a renamed-build benchmark runs in CI. - **Static only.** No `eval`, no sandbox, no WebAssembly instantiation; safe on hostile input. - **Prompt-injection firewall** for text planted to steer the model. - **21 formats**: JavaScript and TypeScript bundles, inline HTML, WebAssembly, Electron ASAR and fuses, source maps, Python and `.pyc`, native ELF/PE/Mach-O, Bun,

title: dabingfy-dot/solo-to-team-skills
body:
Skills for human-led AI teams: delegate tasks, verify evidence, explain steps clearly, and learn from real cases. 一个人统筹 AI 团队：派活、核证、清楚说明、经验复用。

README 節錄：# Solo to Team · 一人成队 **English version: README.en.md** **团队组织与协作报告（PDF，17页）：docs/solo-to-team-value.pdf** 仓名：`solo-to-team-skills` 英文副标题：**Skills for human-led AI teams.** 中文说明：一个人统筹 AI 团队的协作技能包。 署：**大冰发起** > 文档状态：**v0.9-draft**，非最终发布稿，正式公开前还会改。已在多个 Agent 工具中完成实际使用验证（取得→装／配置→按名调用→产出登记行；另外当前包上八家各有一例有限任务的验收记录（真实成果→对照要求检查→人工验收）：Codex 保留此前单独验证的一例，其余七家按同一会议转写题补验，部分宿主经受阻重跑或退回修订后才通过；不代表稳定性或所有任务都能做成，调用方式各家不同（有的由使用者本人在宿主里发出，有的命令行或代点），部分宿主未保留技能加载的原始轨迹；不表示每家四个技能都逐一被调用，也不证明效果），范围：**Codex、WorkBuddy、DeepSeek Harness、Cursor、CodeBuddy、Kimi Work、千问办公（QwenWork）** 写「支持」；**Grok Bot** 写「支持，需手动配置」；**Claude Code** 结构已备、走通待补，不在首发支持之列。 ## 这是什么 一个人，也能带起一支 AI 团队。 这是一套**拿得到、装得上、叫得动**的协作技能包：四支技能＋一个模板＋说明＋脱敏案例。它帮你管住「一个人总控、多个长期 AI 助手」时最容易掉链子的几件事：活派出去有人收，说「做好了」有证据，写给新手的步骤照做就成，踩过的坑留下来给下一个人用。 借鉴的是方法思路；交付的是改写后的中文协作包，外加两支原创技能，并已在多个 Agent 工具里实际装上、按名调用过。借鉴来源见 `NOTICE` 和各技能末尾的来源／借鉴说明。 技能本身不带定时和叫醒（插件清单 `hooks: {}`）：到点查、记接单／收到成果／验收、叫开工，按技能正文里的步骤，由你或你用的 AI 工具来做。 ## 对我有什么用 - **一人成队：派出去的活，接得住、跟得上、收得回来。** 一条线走到底：派 → 收 → 核 → 判。每件活派出去前登记一行「待收」，写明谁在干、谁来收、谁到点查；收回来记「已收到成果」并写明结果在哪，核过证据记「已验收」才算完。登记行让还没人接的活一眼看得见；到点去查、去催，由你或宿主的定时能力来做（分工见下面「首版核心流程」三栏表）。 - **换工具，不必重学一套协作方法。** 四支核心技能的正文各家共用，方法学一次就行；每家从哪装、怎么叫、还要准备什么，按各家真实配置分别写在「各宿主怎么装、怎么叫」。 - **从一张表开始，迈出带领 AI 团队的第一步。** 主示例和登记行模板拿来就能用：先用记事本或表格把「派、收、核」练一遍。这一步练的是方法；想让 AI 助手按名调用技能，还要先装好一个 Agent 工具。 - **从真活里来。** 两个脱敏案例（日更流水线怎样改、验收链怎样抓漏）

body: README 節錄：# sheeridVerify · 教学与研究验证流程工作台 **sheeridVerify** 是一个基于 Node.js 的验证流程学习项目，提供本地 Web 工作台、任务队列、浏览器表单交互及 HTTP 状态查询，供学校教学、学术研究和获得授权的流程测试使用。 > **用途说明：** 本项目仅以教学与研究为目的提供。使用真实平台前应取得必要授权，遵守适用法律和平台条款；不得伪造身份、学籍或材料，不得冒用信息、骗取权益或绕过资格审核。本项目与 SheerID 及任何学校均无官方隶属或认可关系，也不保证验证成功。详情见 用途说明与免责声明，代码许可见 ISC 协议。 ## 文档导航 - 快速开始 - 工作台与接口说明 - Linux / Instabox 部署、更新与排错 - 浏览器流程说明 - 贡献指南 · 安全说明 · 免责声明 ## 功能 - 通过 fetch 读取验证状态，按当前步骤选择浏览器或材料处理流程。 - 在 Web 页面创建、排队、停止、恢复和删除任务；失败任务删除后可重新提交。 - 按配置限制并发，记录任务进度，提交后默认每 5 秒查询结果。 - 上传原始 PNG、JPEG、PDF 文件，不生成或修改证明材料；交互式真人验证由用户完成。 - 使用访问密码、会话 Cookie、来源检查及写请求令牌保护工作台接口。 ## 快速开始 需要 **Node.js >= 22.15** 与 npm。从 GitHub 获取源码： ```bash git clone https://github.com/JenkinWoo/sheeridVerify.git cd sheeridVerify ``` 使用下载的 ZIP 时，解压后进入其中包含 `package.json` 的目录。在项目根目录安装依赖与浏览器： ```bash npm ci npm run browser:install ``` 首次使用时复制配置，已有个人配置请直接编辑原文件。 Windows PowerShell： ```powershell Copy-Item config/sheerid.example.json config/sheerid.local.json ``` Linux / macOS： ```bash cp -n config/sheerid.example.json config/sheerid.local.json ``` 编辑 `config/sheerid.local.json`，设置获授权的国家、学校、`data.organization.emailDomain` 和材料来源。该文件必须是标准 JSON，**不支持 `//` 注释或尾随逗号**。网页会按姓名和配置后缀生成邮箱，仅应使用自己有权使用的真实地址与资料。`document.path` 与 `document.url` 只能填写其中一个；示例配置不包含可直接提交的真实资料。 ```bash npm run web ``` 打开 **http://127.0.0.1:8787**。本地默认访问密码为 `JenkinWoo`；对外开放前必须通过 `ONE_WEB_PASSWORD` 更换密码，并配置 HTTPS 入口。Linux 有界面浏览器需要可用桌面；完整部署步骤和环境变量模板见 部署指南。 ## 测试与贡献 ```bash npm test ``` 测试使用模拟接口及本地页面，不向真实验证接口提交数据。未安装 Camoufox 时会跳过浏览器相关用例；网页

title: llm 0.37.2
body: Release: llm 0.37.2 Fixes a security issue reported by Daniel de Araujo in GHSA-v9h7-jj4g-f862 and GHSA-r639-rr7r-x72w . LLM has a mechanism called extra-openai-models.yaml - now managed by the new-in-0.37 llm openai endpoint add command - for using LLM with OpenAI-compatible API endpoints from other providers. Daniel reported two ways this could accidentally send your configured OpenAI API key to one of those providers: if the key named by api_key_name had never been stored, or if a responses: true model was run with -o chat_completions 1 . body: README 節錄： # ForgeKernel: Self-Evolving Kernels Catching and Surpassing Experts and Agents **English** | 中文 ForgeKernel is a **self-evolving GPU kernel agent** that starts from a **reference kernel**. It reads the reference's architecture by running, timing and profiling it, turns that into an architecture-first milestone curriculum that a coding agent implements, and **promotes every accepted kernel to the next reference**, so optimization keeps going past the best known implementation. Findings certified by a hardware probe accumulate in a **knowledge base shared across operators**. The kernels are released in `kernels/`. title: Show HN: Yogurt – Free, private, open-source alternative to Granola
body: Hey HN, I’m Eric and I want to share an OSS project that I’ve been building in my free time. Yogurt is a free, MIT licensed desktop app that uses on-device AI models to transcribe, summarize, and chat with your meetings. Here's a quick demo video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BFfbXAwRq98 Similar to Granola, Yogurt runs in the background and does not join your calls. But unlike Granola, Yogurt is open-source, free to use, and private. Your meeting transcripts, call recordings, and summaries never leave your computer. As small OSS models have gotten faster and more powerful, Yogurt seemed like a pretty obvious win for privacy and cost conscious folks. You do not need a frontier model to summarize meeting notes or answer questions about them. And if you want to make your notes available to a frontier model, you can just share it with Anthropic, OpenAI, etc. directly via Yogurt’s local MCP server. There’s no need to use a paid cloud service as a middleman. I tried some of the most popular OSS note taking tools, and most were missing features like calendar integration, MCP server, etc. or required you to connect or create an account. And more than that, they didn’t feel polished enough for it to be something I actually wanted to use daily, and so I built Yogurt to scratch that itch.
